periods.name: 恰特村抵达与提妲罗＝达多会面
periods.summary: Kinji, Monkey and Lucifelia travel by truck and camel cart to Chhat, encounter caste-distance customs, sacred stones, local boys selling almond oil, and a smoker who directs them to Dr. Titaro-Dado.
periods.outcome: They meet Titaro-Dado, who agrees to guide them to Carbuncle's ruins and later is revealed as John Watson I.
